meta.defaultTitle: TenderX Nepal — Tender & Joint Venture Bid Workspace | Itahari, Nepal
meta.defaultDescription: TenderX Nepal (tenderx) is Nepal's dedicated tender and joint-venture bid workspace based in Itahari. Manage company profiles, JV partners, signatures, and bid documents in one place.
meta.homeTitle: TenderX Nepal (Tender X Nepal) — Tender & JV Bid Workspace | Itahari
meta.homeDescription: TenderX Nepal — Prepare tenders and bids in Nepal with confidence. Built for Nepali contractors in Itahari and nationwide for joint-venture bids, signatures, and reusable company profiles.
